text:
frank: Heads up— after the keystore migration a subset of SAST/DAST jobs started failing with KMS errors, plus some false-positive noise on an auth check. Repro: pipeline #12011.

olivia: Oncall? paste the error and any stack traces.

frank: Log: ```ERROR: artifact decrypt failed: KMS.PermissionDenied
service: scanner-worker
file: fetcher.go:203```

samir: I saw similar during the vault alias flip. The migration script replaced an HSM-backed alias and the scanner SA wasn't granted access to the new alias. Might be a role/alias mismatch.

frank: Also seeing DAST login tests failing with 401s; could be token decrypt + session issue.

devops-bot: Created incident SEC-2024-1142  "keystore migration: scan failures & auth regressions". Notifying @samir @frank.

olivia: Triage plan: 1) fetch keystore/KMS audit entries for alias change 2) confirm which alias the scanner used 3) apply scoped ephemeral grant to new alias 4) capture failing scan payloads for forensic copy.

samir: I'll grant `roles/kms.decrypter` on alias `projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/scan-key/cryptoKeyVersions/2` to scanner@infra for 30m and log the grant ID.

frank: After the ephemeral grant both SAST and DAST jobs pass. No more 401s. Uploaded artifacts to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-1142/.

olivia: Follow-ups: - rotate the alias mapping so scanner SA is allowed the new alias in long-term IAM - add a pre-merge infra smoke test that exercises KMS alias access for scanner SA - update secure-sdlc checklist to include keystore alias migration steps and rollback plan.

samir: Also noticed the SAST scanner started flagging an internal helper as high-sev due to changed build path. We should file a suppression with evidence rather than blanket ignore. I'll start an SAST FP issue and attach the artifact.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-1142 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-06-20 09:00 UTC.

frank: Can we add an alert rule: if >5 scan jobs in 10m fail with `KMS.PermissionDenied` or `Decrypt denied` then page sec oncall? That would have caught this earlier.

olivia: Agreed. Filing GH issues: #2401 (kms pre-merge smoke), #2402 (alias mapping policy), #2403 (scan-failure alert). Closing thread; evidence in gs bucket. :thumbsup:
